target.description: W0 law of docs/wsp/research/phys_daft_w0.md, section 7.1: what the counter reads, by kind of air, from the photometer reading. The indicators and dusttrak_mass_floored = max(dusttrak_mass_concentration, 1e-9 kg/m3) are derived by tools/wsp/ext/law_inputs.py. (no target is a shared quantity); targets: number_concentration
excludes: phase_end_time is named here only because ModelSpec.target requires one shared quantity: every target of this model is lane-local and no artifact carries phase_end_time
daft:number_concentration (positive, 1/m3): lane-local target, not a shared quantity

features.name: is_cabin
features.transform: identity: (x - x.is_cabin.centre) / x.is_cabin.scale; refused unless x.is_cabin.lo <= x <= x.is_cabin.hi @1

features.name: is_velcro
features.transform: identity: (x - x.is_velcro.centre) / x.is_velcro.scale; refused unless x.is_velcro.lo <= x <= x.is_velcro.hi @1

features.name: is_bag
features.transform: identity: (x - x.is_bag.centre) / x.is_bag.scale; refused unless x.is_bag.lo <= x <= x.is_bag.hi @1

features.name: dusttrak_mass_floored
features.transform: ln: ln(x / x.dusttrak_mass_floored.centre) / x.dusttrak_mass_floored.scale; refused unless x.dusttrak_mass_floored.lo <= x <= x.dusttrak_mass_floored.hi @1

tensors.description: Centre c of the identity transform of is_cabin.

tensors.name: x.is_cabin.scale
tensors.description: Scale s of the identity transform of is_cabin.

tensors.name: x.is_cabin.lo
tensors.description: Lower end of the declared domain of is_cabin (raw SI value).

tensors.name: x.is_cabin.hi
tensors.description: Upper end of the declared domain of is_cabin (raw SI value).

tensors.name: x.is_velcro.centre
tensors.description: Centre c of the identity transform of is_velcro.

tensors.name: x.is_velcro.scale
tensors.description: Scale s of the identity transform of is_velcro.

tensors.name: x.is_velcro.lo
tensors.description: Lower end of the declared domain of is_velcro (raw SI value).

tensors.name: x.is_velcro.hi
tensors.description: Upper end of the declared domain of is_velcro (raw SI value).

tensors.name: x.is_bag.centre
tensors.description: Centre c of the identity transform of is_bag.

tensors.name: x.is_bag.scale
tensors.description: Scale s of the identity transform of is_bag.

tensors.name: x.is_bag.lo
tensors.description: Lower end of the declared domain of is_bag (raw SI value).

tensors.name: x.is_bag.hi
tensors.description: Upper end of the declared domain of is_bag (raw SI value).

tensors.name: x.dusttrak_mass_floored.centre
tensors.description: Centre c of the ln transform of dusttrak_mass_floored.

tensors.name: number_concentration.median.b0
tensors.description: Value of ln(median number_concentration / 1 1/m3) at z = 0 before hinge terms (ln(1/m3)).

tensors.name: number_concentration.median.skip
tensors.description: Linear weights of ln(median number_concentration / 1 1/m3) on z, in feature order; every element is stated.

tensors.name: number_concentration.median.W1
tensors.description: Hinge input weights of ln(median number_concentration / 1 1/m3); row j reads z in feature order.

tensors.name: number_concentration.median.b1
tensors.description: Hinge biases of ln(median number_concentration / 1 1/m3) (hinge positions).

tensors.name: number_concentration.median.w2
tensors.description: Hinge output weights of ln(median number_concentration / 1 1/m3).

tensors.name: number_concentration.spread.b0
tensors.description: Value of the ln-sd of the core component of number_concentration at z = 0 before hinge terms (1).

tensors.name: number_concentration.spread.skip
tensors.description: Linear weights of the ln-sd of the core component of number_concentration on z, in feature order; every element is stated.

tensors.name: number_concentration.spread.W1
tensors.description: Hinge input weights of the ln-sd of the core component of number_concentration; row j reads z in feature order.

tensors.name: number_concentration.spread.b1
tensors.description: Hinge biases of the ln-sd of the core component of number_concentration (hinge positions).

tensors.name: number_concentration.spread.w2
tensors.description: Hinge output weights of the ln-sd of the core component of number_concentration.

tensors.name: number_concentration.tail_weight
tensors.description: Weight of the wider component of number_concentration (0: one log-normal).

tensors.name: number_concentration.tail_width
tensors.description: ln-sd of the wider component of number_concentration over that of the core (1: no wider component).

tensors.name: num.substeps
tensors.description: Integration steps per requested interval of an event target (numerical, not physics).

notes: Generic law forward law.rs, declaration configs/models/law/daft/decl.json (status Declared): {"slug":"daft","status":"declared","family":"other","investigation":"PSI-47, DAFT / DAFT-2: a modified P-Trak condensation counter against a DustTrak photometer on cabin air and on test dust in orbit","description":"W0 law of docs/wsp/research/phys_daft_w0.md, section 7.1: what the counter reads, by kind of air, from the photometer reading. The indicators and dusttrak_mass_floored = max(dusttrak_mass_concentration, 1e-9 kg/m3) are derived by tools/wsp/ext/law_inputs.py.","features":[{"name":"is_cabin","unit":"1","transform":"identity","description":"cabin air through the hose"},{"name":"is_velcro","unit":"1","transform":"identity","description":"cabin air while Velcro is separated"},{"name":"is_bag","unit":"1","transform":"identity","description":"road dust in a bag (filtered air is the reference)"},{"name":"dusttrak_mass_floored","unit":"kg/m3","transform":"ln","description":"max(dusttrak_mass_concentration, 1e-9 kg/m3), the photometer reading floored at its resolution"}],"targets":[{"name":"number_concentration","kind":"positive","unit":"1/m3","shared_quantity":null,"causes":[],"scheduled_stop":null,"description":"what the modified P-Trak reads on the sample (lane-local)"}]}. Each network is N(z) = b0 + skip . z + sum_j w2[j] relu(b1[j] + W1[j, :] . z). A positive target is a mixture of two log-normals of one median exp(N_median), ln-sds N_spread and tail_width * N_spread, weights 1 - tail_weight and tail_weight; a non-positive spread is refused. A binary target is logistic(N_logit). An event target is the competition of log-logistic clocks exp(N_c), shape c.shape, conditioned on no event before the cutoff; the earliest control stage scheduled_stop or flow_stop, and the declared stop condition plus each offset node with a positive weight, take the active mass. Lane-local targets are labelled <slug>:<target> in diagnostics.law and carry no shared quantity. Uncertainty kind: assumed_noise.
